name: haydi
description: WP Admin AI File Assistant (WordPress 7.0 Connectors)

scripts.test: playwright test && npm run test:unit && npm run test:unit:php
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:php
scripts.dist: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/haydi && cp -r admin assets includes haydi.php readme.txt LICENSE dist/haydi/ && terser dist/haydi/assets/admin.js -o dist/haydi/assets/admin.js --compress --mangle && cleancss dist/haydi/assets/admin.css -o dist/haydi/assets/admin.css && cd dist && zip -r haydi.zip haydi && rm -rf haydi && echo 'Created dist/haydi.zip'
